key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole), except ritonavir
key_interactions.effect: Much higher alprazolam levels and adverse reactions (label).
Profound sedation and respiratory depression (label boxed warning).
key_interactions.action: Limit dose and duration; monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation.

key_interactions.effect: Inhibitors raise alprazolam adverse effects; inducers reduce efficacy (label).
